title: 第一章 我穿越了？
slug: 电锯人开局契约斩杀线恶魔
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

东京，新宿区。

深夜十一时。

从睡梦中醒来的言良睁开了眼睛，他下意识想揉一下隐隐作痛的太阳穴，却突然发现双臂竟被粗糙的麻绳反绑在了椅子上。

一瞬间，残存的睡意彻底消失。

言良环顾四周，这里似乎是一栋废弃大楼的内部，窗户全被砖块和木条封死，只有头顶几盏工地灯散发昏黄的光。地面到处都是开裂的水泥，裂缝纵横交错，有些宽到能塞进手指。

大厅正中央则是摆着一张绿色绒布面的赌桌，四周排列着椅子，每把椅子上坐着一个人，约莫二十来个。

无一例外，他们的手都被绑着。

这是哪里？

言良抿着嘴，他明明记得昨晚自己刚投完简历，正躺在床上看着《电锯人》漫画，看着看着就睡着了。怎么一觉醒来，就来到这么一个鬼地方？

整蛊节目？被绑架了？到底是什么情况……

“放、放我们走……”

身旁突然传来一声细微得像蚊子般的呜咽，打断了言良的思绪。他艰难地转过头，顺着源头望去——

那是一个缩在椅子上的少女。五官清秀，深棕色的短发上别着两个显眼的红色发卡，左眼下方，还有着两颗小小的泪痣。

言良的目光锁在少女身上，瞳孔都不自觉地放大了。

他认得这个少女，无论是外貌，还是神态，以及这胆小怕事的模样，都与漫画《电锯人》中的东山小红如出一辙！

难道……

穿越了？

不，哪有这么夸张？

现实中长得像动漫角色的人又不是没有，cosplay也说不定……言良摇了摇头，理性第一时间强行将这个荒谬的念头按了下去。

比起睡个觉就穿越，他更宁愿相信这家伙是准备参加漫展的二次元。

而还没等他理清思绪，前方厚重的铁门就被推开了。

十多个穿着短袖的壮硕男人先走了进来，站定之后，一把轮椅被推了进来。

轮椅上坐着一个年轻男人，只有一只眼睛。浑身上下，包括脸部都带着大面积的烧伤疤痕，右臂从肩膀以下完全缺失，两条腿干瘦如枯柴。西装穿在他身上，就像挂在衣架上一样滑稽。

而站在他背上的东西，让言良的心都提到了嗓子眼。

那是一个绝对不可能在现实中出现的怪物，头部是一颗缓缓旋转的骰子，链接着一个透明的玻璃躯干，里面浸泡着密密麻麻的人类手指、牙齿和眼球。

Page (1/3)

Tokyo, Shinjuku Ward.

Eleven o'clock at night.

Yan Liang woke up from his sleep and opened his eyes. He subconsciously wanted to rub his aching temples, but suddenly found that his arms were tied to the chair with rough hemp ropes behind his back.

In an instant, the remaining sleepiness completely disappeared.

Yan Liang looked around. It seemed to be the inside of an abandoned building. The windows were all sealed with bricks and wooden bars, and only a few construction site lights overhead gave off a dim light.The ground is littered with cracked cement, criss-crossed with cracks, some wide enough to fit a finger into.

In the center of the hall is a green velvet-covered gaming table, with chairs arranged around it. There is one person sitting on each chair, about twenty or so.

Without exception, their hands were tied.

Where is this?

Yan Liang pursed his lips. He clearly remembered that he had just submitted his resume last night and was lying on the bed reading the "Chainsaw Man" comic. He fell asleep while reading it.Why did I wake up in such a ghost place?

A prank show?Kidnapped?What is going on...

"Let, let us go..."

A whimper as subtle as a mosquito suddenly came from beside him, interrupting Yan Liang's thoughts.He turned his head with difficulty and looked towards the source——

It was a girl huddled in a chair.She has delicate features, short dark brown hair with two conspicuous red hairpins, and two small tear moles under her left eye.

Yan Liang's eyes were locked on the girl, and his pupils dilated unconsciously.

He recognized this girl. Whether it was her appearance, demeanor, or timid appearance, she was exactly the same as Dongshan Xiaohong in the comic "Chainsaw Man"!

Could it be...

Traveled through time?

No, how could it be such an exaggeration?

It's not like there aren't people who look like anime characters in real life, and maybe cosplay... Yan Liang shook his head, and rationally suppressed this ridiculous idea immediately.

Rather than traveling back in time after sleeping, he would rather believe that this guy was from the second dimension preparing to participate in the Comic Con.

Before he could clear his thoughts, the heavy iron door in front of him was pushed open.

More than a dozen strong men in short-sleeved shirts walked in first. After standing still, a wheelchair was pushed in.

Sitting in a wheelchair was a young man with only one eye.There were extensive burn scars all over his body, including his face. His right arm was completely missing from the shoulder down, and his legs were as thin as dry wood.The suit looked as funny on him as it did on a hanger.

And what stood on his back made Yan Liang's heart rise to his throat.

It was a monster that was absolutely impossible to appear in reality. Its head was a slowly rotating dice, connected to a transparent glass torso, which was filled with densely packed human fingers, teeth and eyeballs.
